o1.speaker: monk
o1.text: Look at me, child. You always wanted to see my face.

o2.speaker: narrator
o2.text: Beneath the cracked noh mask, another mask. Red. Horned. Crowned in gold. Beneath that - nothing he would ever show.

choices.text: You were the only father I had.

o_give.speaker: narrator
o_give.text: No. Not again. Somewhere behind you, an old man in orange robes is holding up a lamp.

o_father.speaker: monk
o_father.text: And I was a good one. I fed you. I sharpened you. What is love, if not that?

o_f.speaker: monk
o_f.text: Come, then. Let us see whose light this world believes in.  (Only SACRED LIGHT - Q - truly wounds him.)
